description: This file contains Spring Boot configuration for auditing and request filtering in a Java-based microservice. It enables JPA auditing and registers a custom filter for authentication purposes.

classes.name: AuditConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that enables JPA auditing and registers a filter for user authentication.

methods.name: myAuditorProvider
methods.description: Defines a bean providing current auditor information for auditing purposes.

methods.name: authUserFilter
methods.description: Defines a bean registering a filter to intercept API requests for authentication.
